The Authentic Name

Scholarly reference for XšaθraVairya

Avestan

𐬑𐬱𐬀𐬚𐬭𐬀 𐬬𐬀𐬌𐬭𐬌𐬌𐬀

The name in its original Avestan form. 𐬑𐬱𐬀𐬚𐬭𐬀 𐬬𐬀𐬌𐬭𐬌𐬌𐬀 → XšaθraVairya. The initial cluster xš- is written with x (𐬑) and š (𐬱). · The medial θ in Xšaθra corresponds to the Avestan letter θ (𐬚). · Vairiia writes the glide -y- with a doubled i (𐬌𐬌), a common Avestan orthography.

ASCII Constraint

KHSHATHRAVAIRYA

Stripped of its identity, the name was reduced to plain Latin letters. The original orthography — stress, length, breathing — was erased by systems that only understand A-Z.

Unicode Restoration

XšaθraVairya

The Unicode restoration recovers what ASCII destroyed. This is philological accuracy — not decoration. The domain encodes to Punycode, but the browser displays the truth.

Punycode Encoding
xšaθravairya.com → xn--xaravairya-09b303e.com

The non-ASCII characters in XšaθraVairya are encoded while the ASCII remains visible. To the DNS, it is Punycode. To humanity, it is XšaθraVairya. PUNYCODEX does not claim this domain is available; always verify status with a registrar.

Tier Classification

Why XšaθraVairya is classified as Tier-2 Basic

The Zoroastrian form 𐬑𐬱𐬀𐬚𐬭𐬀 𐬬𐬀𐬌𐬭𐬌𐬌𐬀 preserves neither stress nor length in this Unicode restoration. This makes it a single-tier Tier-2 Basic name — still a scholarly step above plain ASCII, but without the distinctive phonetic features that define higher tiers.
